title: @junopark: We owe it to each other

versions.body:
There are strong feelings about the Waterfront, I know. I think we owe it to each other to keep listening. Change can be scary, but it can also be good 💛

Talked about the Waterfront at the school gate this morning. I think we owe it to each other to keep listening. Change can be scary, but it can also be good.

That is all I have. Also the team lost 4–1, but we do not have to talk about that.
